Custom imuGAP fit extraction

Source: R/imuGAP.R
extract_imugap.Rd

Thin wrapper around backend extract to extract typical imuGAP parameters.

Usage

extract_imugap(fit, pars = c("beta_bs"), ...)

Arguments

fit

an object of class imugap_fit returned by [sampling()].

pars

character vector of parameter names to extract (default: "beta_bs").

...

additional arguments passed to the backend extract method.

Value

a list, of extracted parameter arrays as returned by the backend.

Examples

data("fit_sim")
extract_imugap(fit_sim)
